description: Open-source BLE controller for a hot water mat (KDO_HotWaterMat): status, per-side temperature and power from a Go CLI, no vendor app or cloud.
rules: Drive the mat through the hotwatermat-ble CLI (status, temp --left/--right, on, off); add --verify to temp/on/off to confirm the result.
Target temperatures must be 28.0-48.0°C in 0.5°C steps.
Run one command at a time: the mat accepts a single BLE connection, and the vendor app must be closed.
setup is interactive: ask the user to run it. Otherwise set HOTWATERMAT_ADDRESS and HOTWATERMAT_DEVICE_GID, or pass --address and --device-gid.
The DeviceGid is the mat's authentication key: never print it in full or commit it.
Protocol packets are 20 bytes with checksum sum(bytes[1:19]) & 0xFF at byte 19; read STATUS on CHAR1 (0100dd), write everything to CHAR2 (0200dd).
